scope: Proposition 3.2 (Good critical clusters) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness of percolation on nonamenable quasi-transitive graphs” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-of-percolation-on-nonamenable-quasi-transitive-graphs-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 214 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46a78d044d2713e4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each ϵ ∈ (0, 1/2), uniformly in x and for all sufficiently large M, Ppc (sx ≤ M, Cx is not good for cap M) ≤ e−Mϵ . (3.1) The event that a cluster has size at most M and is good for cap M is determined by the percolation bits in a deterministic finite-radius ball about its root.
